name: Omega
title: Voyager Savior Party
description: An artificial intelligence from a super-ancient civilization sealed within the Captain's sword. She joins the Voyager Savior Party in search of the family she was separated from long ago.
introduction:
An AI of an ultra-ancient civilization installed in Star Piercer, the sword wielded by the Captain.
After spending a long time alone inside Star Piercer, Omega was able to venture out into the world after meeting the Captain.

She refers to the Captain as Mister because he smells similar to her creator, and sets out with him to learn what mission her "Daddy" gave her.

Although her free manipulation of mass-bearing projections makes her seem almost omnipotent, her innocence and simple nature often lead to her exacerbating problems as she tries to solve them.
